subject: QUEUED BACKLOG: MIMO-5 — Full-Board Conformal Calibration Across All Active Sports
body:
Mimo: Queued pipeline task (to begin immediately following MIMO-4 completion).

Objective: Generate production Mondrian conformal intervals across all live board fixtures.
1. Ingest board-export.jsonl and map calibrated intervals [y_lo, y_hi] per sport (NFL, NCAAF, MLB, WNBA).
2. For each active market, compute the 90% and 80% coverage interval boundaries with finite-sample corrections.
3. Verify that zero intervals produce infinite width or clamped bounds.
4. Output to out/live_board_conformal_intervals.json.
